criteria.title: Layout parity
checks: the app title is the Creator application name
each form shows its fields in the Creator field order
each titled Creator section field is a heading in its form
each form, report and page route renders without a not-generated placeholder
phone: a multi-column form layout collapses to one column

criteria.title: Navigation (desktop menu; phone tab bar and More)
checks: desktop: every visible Creator section is a menu group with its label
desktop: every form, report and page of a visible section is a menu link with its Creator label
desktop: the link of the open route is marked current
phone: the tab bar has between one and five entries, each with a name
phone: when the menu has more destinations than tabs, a More control opens a sheet and Escape closes it
phone: every menu destination is a tab or a More sheet link

criteria.title: Forms and fields
checks: each form route renders a form headed with the Creator form label
each input field of the Creator form is present
each field's control suits its Creator type (choice, date, file, composite, subform, ...)
each field's label is its Creator label
each mandatory Creator field is marked required

criteria.title: Reports and columns
checks: each report route renders a report headed with the Creator report label
desktop: each Creator column label is shown
phone: the phone quick view columns (or the first four) are shown on the record card
a chart or pivot report renders a chart area

criteria.title: Actions
checks: each form has a submit button
each Creator form button label is a button
each Creator report custom action is a button
each record of a form-backed report can be opened or edited

criteria.title: Empty and error states
checks: a report with no records shows an empty state
a report whose data call fails shows an error with a retry
submitting a form with an empty mandatory field shows a field error
a slow report shows a busy loading state (measured, not yet scored)
a destructive action asks for confirmation first (measured, not yet scored)
a second submit while busy posts once (measured, not yet scored)
a 403 shows a denied screen with a way home, no dead retry (measured, not yet scored)
an unknown route shows a not-found screen with a way home and focus (measured, not yet scored)
a write result shows a toast that dismisses or closes (measured, not yet scored)
a route change focuses the screen heading and retitles the document (measured, not yet scored)

criteria.title: Accessibility basics
checks: the document has a language and a title
a skip link leads to the main landmark
every navigation landmark has a name
every form control and button on every route has an accessible name
no route repeats an element id
phone: the More control states its popup and expanded state; the sheet is a dialog

criteria.title: Responsiveness
checks: the page declares a device-width viewport
desktop: the menu is shown and the tab bar is hidden
phone: the menu is hidden and the tab bar is shown
phone: the More sheet is a fixed overlay
phone: report rows become cards or the table scrolls sideways
